description: Weekly, minor and patch grouped, each release at least 7 days old (security fixes excepted). Majors are off. gogdl_flutter, the CI image tag and .fvmrc move by hand, together; the CI image digest moves weekly.

packageRules.description: Pin CI images (OSV-Scanner, Renovate, the infra/ci-images CI image) by digest; digest updates then come in the grouped MR.
Semver-major updates are handled by hand.
One MR for all minor, patch and digest updates.

The infra/ci-images flutter-rust tag names Flutter, Rust and frb, which must match .fvmrc and the gogdl_flutter tag in pubspec.yaml: it moves by hand with them. Renovate only moves its digest, after ci-images' weekly rebuild.
